# Enterprise size

## Type A: Growing-up manufacturing and equipment enterprises

| Classification of information | Specific content |
| --- | --- |
| Organisational characteristics | Some 50-500 people, multi-sectoral, multi-silo, multi-sKU; |
| Organisational characteristics | (a) The interaction between sales, procurement, inventory, production and sale; |
| Organisational characteristics | There is still a large number of spreadsheets, mainstream social tool sets, paper files and duplicate entries; |
| Organisational characteristics | Existing ERPs are heavier or do not cover non-target processes. |
| HF problems | Material, inventory and after-sale work orders cannot be linked in real time; |
| HF problems | (a) Unsatisfactory sales forecasts, procurement plans and financial returns; |
| HF problems | A manual summary of the statements is required for decision-making; |
| HF problems | Business is changing fast and traditional development is not keeping pace. |
| Reasons for purchase | Visualizing configuration quickly adapts non-standardized processes; |
| Reasons for purchase | Harmonized data base to reduce inter-system moves; |
| Reasons for purchase | AI Forecasting, asking questions and automation bring visible efficiency gains; |
| Reasons for purchase | This can be done from the CRM, procurement or inventory points. |
| Evidence trail. | Kuailu's public ProAvanti medical equipment case covers cross-regional sales, procurement, administration, technical support, installation maintenance and multi-SKU inventories, with the CRM/EMS/WMS integration solution. |
| Evidence trail. | [Source: ProAvanti Case] |

## Type D: digitized start-up SMEs

| Classification of information | Specific content |
| --- | --- |
| Organisational characteristics | 10-100 persons, the owner directly involved in the procurement; |
| Organisational characteristics | IT has few or no full-time IT personnel; |
| Organisational characteristics | (b) budget sensitive and fast-tracked; |
| Organisational characteristics | Demand is concentrated on standard modules such as write-offs, CRMs, approvals, finance, personnel, etc. |
| Reasons for purchase | Annual fees are manageable; |
| Reasons for purchase | (a) Templates are open for use; |
| Reasons for purchase | Visualisation reduces customization dependency; |
| Reasons for purchase | Free trial to reduce the risk of initial decision-making. |
